title: SEW: Self-Evolving Agentic Workflows for Automated Code Generation
problem: Manually designed agent topologies and prompts limit adaptation to different coding problems.
assumption_broken: Both workflow structure and the mutation prompts used to improve agents can be evolved automatically.
operational_signature: Generate → mutate → execute → select
load_bearing_mechanism: Joint workflow and agent-prompt evolution includes hyper-evolution that modifies mutation prompts before applying them.

title: Promptbreeder: Self-Referential Self-Improvement Via Prompt Evolution
problem: Hand-crafted prompting strategies and iterative prompt search can plateau before discovering effective domain-specific reasoning instructions.
assumption_broken: The mutation instructions governing prompt search can evolve alongside the task prompts rather than remaining fixed.
operational_signature: Initialize paired candidates → evaluate fitness → select winners → mutate candidates and mutation rules → replace losers
load_bearing_mechanism: Evolution jointly retains task prompts and their mutation prompts, allowing the prompt generator itself to improve through hyper-mutation.

title: Mimosa Framework: Toward Evolving Multi-Agent Systems for Scientific Research
problem: Fixed scientific multi-agent workflows cannot adapt topology and tool allocation to execution failures.
assumption_broken: Agent decomposition and communication topology should be optimized per task rather than fixed in advance.
operational_signature: Discover tools → synthesize graph → execute → judge → mutate and accept
load_bearing_mechanism: LLM-guided local edits to prompts, nodes, and edges are accepted when workflow judge scores improve.

title: Structurally Aligned Subtask-Level Memory for Software Engineering Agents
problem: Instance-level memory retrieval confuses globally similar issues with locally different reasoning requirements.
assumption_broken: The whole issue-solving episode need not be the atomic unit of memory storage and retrieval.
operational_signature: Segment functional intent → filter and retrieve → execute subtask → abstract and append experience
load_bearing_mechanism: Hard functional-category filtering followed by local-intent similarity aligns reusable experience with the current reasoning stage.

title: MetaGen: Self-Evolving Roles and Topologies for Multi-Agent LLM Reasoning
problem: Fixed role libraries and frozen communication graphs mismatch tasks and cannot adapt to evidence emerging during reasoning.
assumption_broken: Role prompts and collaboration topology can both change during inference without backbone fine-tuning.
operational_signature: Generate roles → instantiate sparse graph → refine from feedback → cache verified specialists
load_bearing_mechanism: Within-instance role and edge edits combine with reward-updated cross-instance selection priors and verified role reuse.

title: MetaAgent: Automatically Constructing Multi-Agent Systems Based on Finite State Machines
problem: Automatically designed agent teams lack tool feedback, reusable task-level structure, and error traceback.
assumption_broken: Agent coordination can use reusable finite state machines with backward transitions rather than rigid linear communication.
operational_signature: Design roles and states → merge redundant states → execute transitions → verify and backtrack
load_bearing_mechanism: LLM-verified state transitions enable iterative refinement and traceback while state merging removes redundant coordination.

title: Inducing Programmatic Skills for Agentic Tasks
problem: Textual skill memories lack executable verification and do not reduce low-level action planning burdens.
assumption_broken: Online agent skills can be executable action abstractions rather than free-form advice in memory.
operational_signature: Execute → abstract → verify → incorporate
load_bearing_mechanism: Programmatic skills enter the action space only after replay verifies task success, actual skill usage, and environment changes.

title: ForeDreamer: A Self-Evolving Dual-Agent Memory Architecture for Future Event Prediction
problem: Noisy open-web retrieval overwhelms forecasting agents and simple memory reuse does not improve evidence processing.
assumption_broken: Persistent memory should encode how evidence is processed as well as what forecasting lessons are retained.
operational_signature: Search → structure → forecast → critique → revise → validate
load_bearing_mechanism: Dual-track evolution jointly refines forecasting experience and executable evidence-processing guides with tool reuse and diverse exploration.

title: LLM Agents Making Agent Tools
problem: Scientific code repositories require labor-intensive environment setup and adaptation before agents can use them as tools.
assumption_broken: Agent tools must be manually integrated or generated entirely from scratch.
operational_signature: Install and snapshot → implement → execute and assess → diagnose and revise
load_bearing_mechanism: Captured installation actions and environment resets make closed-loop debugging produce reproducible repository-backed tools.

title: SkillRevise: Improving LLM-Authored Agent Skills via Trace-Conditioned Skill Revision
problem: Cold-start LLM-authored skills can be well formed but behaviorally ineffective without execution-grounded repair.
assumption_broken: Useful skill refinement need not await a large accumulated trajectory corpus or expert-authored skills.
operational_signature: Execute → diagnose → retrieve → anchor → revise → recheck → retain
load_bearing_mechanism: Diagnosis-bound repair principles induce executable behavioral edits that are re-run and selected by measured utility.

title: Plum: Prompt Learning using Metaheuristic
problem: General interpretable prompt optimization must work without gradients or internal model access.
assumption_broken: Prompt transformations and search strategies can be decoupled rather than fixed to a single heuristic.
operational_signature: Segment candidates → edit or recombine → score outcomes → retain and repeat
load_bearing_mechanism: Composable prompt neighborhoods let discrete metaheuristics search effectively under limited evaluation budgets.

title: Eureka: Human-Level Reward Design via Coding Large Language Models
problem: Manually engineering dense rewards for complex robotic skills is slow and often suboptimal.
assumption_broken: Reward generation need not be restricted to task-specific templates or human-designed reward primitives.
operational_signature: Generate candidates → execute training → summarize component dynamics → mutate the best candidate
load_bearing_mechanism: Component-level reward reflection grounds evolutionary edits in observed policy training dynamics.

title: In Prospect and Retrospect: Reflective Memory Management for Long-term Personalized Dialogue Agents
problem: Rigid memory granularity and fixed retrieval limit long-term personalized dialogue.
assumption_broken: Retrieval can adapt online without labeled relevance data by using the generator's memory citations as feedback.
operational_signature: Summarize → retrieve → cite → reinforce
load_bearing_mechanism: Citation-derived binary rewards train a lightweight memory reranker while topic-based summaries consolidate conversation history.

title: ExpSeek: Self-Triggered Experience Seeking for Web Agents
problem: Global pre-task experience injection cannot respond to changing observations and confusion during web-agent execution.
assumption_broken: Experience guidance can be sought proactively at uncertain intermediate steps rather than injected once before execution.
operational_signature: Contrast trajectories → distill guidance → detect uncertainty → retrieve and adapt experience
load_bearing_mechanism: Step-type-specific entropy thresholds trigger contextualized experience guidance only when the agent is likely to need it.

title: Memora: A Harmonic Memory Representation Balancing Abstraction and Specificity
problem: Memory abstraction discards useful details while unstructured specificity fragments information and burdens retrieval.
assumption_broken: Memory content and its retrieval index need not share the same representation.
operational_signature: Extract concepts → consolidate details → link cues → navigate adaptively
load_bearing_mechanism: Stable primary abstractions consolidate detailed values while many-to-many cue anchors expose nonlocal retrieval paths.

title: COMFYCLAW: Self-Evolving Skill Harnesses for Image Generation Workflows
problem: Image workflow agents repeatedly rediscover repairs and can break executable graphs during visual refinement.
assumption_broken: Workflow control skills can be actively revised from execution and visual feedback rather than remaining static.
operational_signature: Construct → render → verify → repair → cluster → validate → retain
load_bearing_mechanism: Clustered workflow traces produce skill mutations retained only after non-degradation on synthesized validation prompts.

title: Self-Taught Optimizer (STOP): Recursively Self-Improving Code Generation
problem: Manually written language-model scaffolds restrict the quality of generated programs and require human optimizer design.
assumption_broken: A program-improvement scaffold can be submitted to its own improvement procedure rather than remaining fixed.
operational_signature: Propose program edits → evaluate utility → retain best program → apply improver to itself → reuse improved improver
load_bearing_mechanism: The same LM-infused program optimizer rewrites its own scaffolding to discover stronger program-search strategies.

title: AutoEnv: Automated Environments for Measuring Cross-Environment Agent Learning
problem: Fixed agent-learning methods lose effectiveness as environment rules become more heterogeneous.
assumption_broken: The learning method itself need not remain fixed across environments.
operational_signature: Generate worlds → collect trajectories → edit components → select candidates → evaluate
load_bearing_mechanism: A component-centric selection, optimization, and evaluation formulation exposes environment-specific learning-method combinations for comparison.

title: RRSI: Regularized Recursive Self-Improvement of Agent Harnesses
problem: Repeated harness evolution on finite feedback overfits benchmarks, chases noise, and accumulates costly complexity.
assumption_broken: Unrestricted harness editability does not require unconstrained proposal capacity or score-only candidate acceptance.
operational_signature: Constrain → propose → screen → evaluate → regularize → prune → retain
load_bearing_mechanism: Annealed edit sparsity and evidence-aware exploration combine with leakage screening and noise-and-cost-aware selection to favor transferable mechanisms.

title: ExpHarness: Model-Agnostic Experience Learning through a Trainable Harness
problem: Frozen executors cannot reliably exploit prior experience using similarity-only, task-invariant retrieval.
assumption_broken: Experience learning can reside in a trainable external harness while the executor remains frozen and replaceable.
operational_signature: Distill → link → control → retrieve → compare → update
load_bearing_mechanism: A PPO-trained retrieval copilot controls graph exploration and utility weighting using with-versus-without-experience task rewards.

title: ReCreate: Reasoning and Creating Domain Agents Driven by Experience
problem: Metric-only scaffold search discards causal execution evidence and requires expensive trial-and-error agent creation.
assumption_broken: Scaffold updates can be derived from inspectable execution experience rather than black-box performance scores or fixed component pools.
operational_signature: Inspect experience → diagnose patterns → propose local edits → consolidate domain updates
load_bearing_mechanism: An optimizer agent actively retrieves execution evidence and generalizes instance-specific proposals into reusable domain scaffold changes.

title: From Failed Trajectories to Reliable LLM Agents: Diagnosing and Repairing Harness Flaws
problem: Outcome-driven harness optimization cannot reliably locate implementation mechanisms causing agent failures.
assumption_broken: Failed trajectories can be compiled into implementation-aligned diagnostic evidence rather than summarized as final scores.
operational_signature: Align traces → attribute recurring flaws → patch scoped mechanisms → validate regressions
load_bearing_mechanism: A trace intermediate representation links failure steps to editable artifacts and constrains repairs through flaw-specific specifications.

title: PsychAgent: An Experience-Driven Lifelong Learning Agent for Self-Evolving Psychological Counselor
problem: Static counseling models fail to accumulate longitudinal client context and internalize experience-derived intervention strategies.
assumption_broken: Counseling capabilities can evolve through explicit skill acquisition and subsequent parameter internalization instead of static dialogue imitation.
operational_signature: Recall client context → plan session → sample interventions → score trajectories → evolve skills and fine-tune
load_bearing_mechanism: High-reward session trajectories both expand a hierarchical therapeutic skill tree and supply rejection fine-tuning targets.

title: Performance of Bounded-Rational Agents With the Ability to Self-Modify
problem: Determine whether self-modification safety survives bounded rationality and imperfect knowledge.
assumption_broken: Near-optimal decision making need not preserve the goal-stability guarantees of perfect rationality.
operational_signature: Bound errors → model self-modification → propagate value loss → compare guarantees
load_bearing_mechanism: Worst-case value-loss bounds distinguish exponentially compounding optimization errors from noncompounding knowledge errors.

title: SGMem: Sentence Graph Memory for Long-Term Conversational Agents
problem: Fragmented dialogue history and generated memories hinder coherent long-term retrieval.
assumption_broken: Conversational memory graphs need not rely on costly extracted entity-relation triples or coarse chunks alone.
operational_signature: Segment → embed → link → retrieve → expand → integrate
load_bearing_mechanism: Sentence-level similarity graphs recover coherent parent chunks and combine them with generated memory.

title: ScienceBuddy: Recursive-in-Recursive Self-Improvement for Interactive Scientific Agents
problem: Scientific collaboration feedback rarely becomes sustained improvement in both reusable agent procedures and model capabilities.
assumption_broken: Harness adaptation and policy training can be coupled across cycles rather than optimized as independent endpoints.
operational_signature: Collect → reconstruct → diagnose → revise → evaluate → train → repeat
load_bearing_mechanism: An inner fixed-model harness loop shapes fresh rubric-rewarded rollouts for an outer model-training loop.

title: Skills-Coach: A Self-Evolving Skill Optimizer via Training-Free GRPO
problem: Individually authored skills have fragmented capability coverage and brittle behavior on advanced tasks.
assumption_broken: Skill instructions and executable code can be jointly improved using a small automatically generated task suite without parameter training.
operational_signature: Generate boundary tasks → propose variants → execute and compare → select and repair
load_bearing_mechanism: Group-relative evaluation selects skill instruction variants while execution-grounded auto-fixing repairs associated code.

title: Meta^n: Recursive Self-Improvement through Emergent Depth
problem: Flat self-refinement cannot reason over the strategic code and decisions that generated earlier solver behavior.
assumption_broken: Increasing meta-depth does not require mutating the improver; a fixed operator can recurse over its growing products.
operational_signature: Inspect → contextualize → synthesize → wrap → evaluate → deepen
load_bearing_mechanism: Successive layers consume both lower-stack traces and code and pass strategic context inward with reusable helper libraries.

title: SEDM: Selective Self-Evolving Distributed Memory for Agents
problem: Indiscriminate sharing and injection of agent memories increases cost and can reduce success.
assumption_broken: Relevant or previously useful memory should not automatically be retained or used for every recipient.
operational_signature: Replay → admit → rank → abstract → calibrate → gate
load_bearing_mechanism: Paired outcomes estimate memory utility for admission and train a calibrated gate that weighs expected success gains against context cost.

title: Dr. Zero: Self-Evolving Search Agents without Training Data
problem: Data-free search-agent training suffers from homogeneous easy questions and expensive nested proposer-solver sampling.
assumption_broken: Search agents can learn from search-grounded questions they generate themselves rather than curated human QA pairs.
operational_signature: Search and propose → measure solvability → group structural peers → update proposer and solver
load_bearing_mechanism: Hop-grouped advantage estimation makes adaptive difficulty-guided proposer training affordable for multi-turn search.

title: Bian Que: An Agentic Framework with Flexible Skill Arrangement for Online System Operations
problem: Operational agents must select event-specific data and knowledge without drowning in irrelevant monitoring signals.
assumption_broken: Event-to-data-and-knowledge mappings can be generated and corrected as skills instead of manually maintained static configurations.
operational_signature: Match context → retrieve and diagnose → receive correction → refine skills and distill knowledge
load_bearing_mechanism: A single practitioner correction updates both operational knowledge and skill-specific retrieval or reasoning specifications.

title: Recursive self-improvement of AI research agents
problem: Research agents optimize external artifacts while their own research efficiency remains fixed.
assumption_broken: An agent's search policy, memory, and verification code can themselves become the subject of recursive research optimization.
operational_signature: Rewrite → benchmark → privately grade → promote → repeat → transfer
load_bearing_mechanism: Bi-level code search selects agent rewrites on private task scores under fixed per-task research budgets.

title: MAS-GPT: Training LLMs to Build LLM-based Multi-Agent Systems
problem: Building query-adaptive multi-agent systems requires manual design or expensive repeated model calls.
assumption_broken: Multi-agent system construction can be learned as single-pass code generation instead of repeated online search.
operational_signature: Enumerate → evaluate → align → distill
load_bearing_mechanism: Consistency-oriented selection and refinement of successful query-system pairs trains a generalizable system generator.

title: EvoMemBench: Benchmarking Agent Memory from a Self-Evolving Perspective
problem: Memory evaluations do not jointly separate within-episode and cross-episode adaptation from knowledge and execution demands.
assumption_broken: A single memory representation or aggregate task score need not characterize adaptive memory effectiveness.
operational_signature: Partition memory demands → update experience sequentially → freeze for transfer → compare accuracy and cost
load_bearing_mechanism: A two-axis standardized benchmark isolates memory scope and content while comparing explicit memory against strong long-context baselines.

title: MemInsight: Autonomous Memory Augmentation for LLM Agents
problem: Growing unstructured interaction histories make relevant memories difficult to retrieve.
assumption_broken: Memory attributes can be autonomously mined from content instead of relying solely on raw dialogue representations.
operational_signature: Mine → annotate → prioritize → retrieve
load_bearing_mechanism: LLM-generated attribute-value annotations structure memories and queries for attribute-filtered or embedding-based retrieval.

title: EmbodiSkill: Skill-Aware Reflection for Self-Evolving Embodied Agents
problem: Coarse trajectory-based skill rewriting corrupts valid guidance when failures are execution lapses.
assumption_broken: A failed execution does not imply that the skill itself needs correction.
operational_signature: Execute → attribute evidence → consolidate → selectively revise
load_bearing_mechanism: Skill-aware attribution separates substantive defects from execution lapses and routes the latter to a reminder appendix.

title: SHARP: A Self-Evolving Human-Auditable Rubric Policy for Financial Trading Agents
problem: Noisy delayed trading rewards cause free-form prompt optimization to drift through poor credit assignment.
assumption_broken: Trading adaptation can operate through localized auditable rule edits rather than unrestricted prompt rewriting.
operational_signature: Backtest → attribute recurring losses → mutate atomic rules → validate walk-forward
load_bearing_mechanism: Cross-sample rule-level attribution guides atomic rubric edits gated by held-out validation with an exploration tolerance.

title: VeriAgent: A Tool-Integrated Multi-Agent System with Evolving Memory for PPA-Aware RTL Code Generation
problem: RTL generation optimizes correctness without accumulating reusable physical-design optimization experience.
assumption_broken: EDA feedback need not remain transient or optimize correctness alone.
operational_signature: Generate → execute → abstract feedback → update memory → retrieve guidance
load_bearing_mechanism: A memory manager inserts, refines, or discards triggered optimization rules extracted from verification and synthesis trajectories.

title: Self-Improving Customer Review Response Generation Based on LLMs
problem: High volumes of app reviews make accurate app-specific customer responses difficult to produce manually.
assumption_broken: Response-generation prompts can improve automatically through category-specific judge feedback rather than manual prompt engineering.
operational_signature: Generate grounded responses → judge dimensions → diagnose weak cases → rewrite and rescore prompts
load_bearing_mechanism: Category-specific LLM critiques of low-scoring responses are distilled into reusable prompt instructions.

title: Memory Beyond Recall: A Dual-Process Cognitive Memory System for Self-Evolving LLM Agents
problem: Retrieval-only memory loses belief evolution and latent cross-domain personalization patterns.
assumption_broken: Long-term memory requires asynchronous abstraction and revision structure beyond passage retrieval.
operational_signature: Persist and reconcile → link revisions → induce schemas → abstract cross-domain patterns
load_bearing_mechanism: A dual-process memory combines supersedes chains with behavioral-similarity collisions that induce higher-level schemas.

title: TaskCraft: Automated Generation of Agentic Tasks
problem: Human annotation limits scalable creation of verifiable multi-tool agent tasks.
assumption_broken: Complex tasks can be built and verified incrementally even when the generating agent cannot solve the whole task.
operational_signature: Generate atomic challenges → verify tool necessity → compose harder challenges → select effective exemplars
load_bearing_mechanism: Depth and width composition preserve known trajectories while generated exemplars bootstrap higher-yield generation prompts.

title: AtlasVA: Self-Evolving Visual Skill Memory for Teacher-Free VLM Agents
problem: Text-only memories lose geometric information and provide poorly grounded feedback for spatial policy learning.
assumption_broken: Experience and learning rewards can share evolving visual spatial priors without a proprietary language-model teacher.
operational_signature: Accumulate trajectories → update spatial priors → shape rewards → optimize and repeat
load_bearing_mechanism: Trajectory-derived danger and affinity atlases jointly supply visual memory and dense policy-learning rewards.

title: Zep: A Temporal Knowledge Graph Architecture for Agent Memory
problem: Static retrieval cannot maintain evolving conversational facts and their temporal relationships.
assumption_broken: Agent memory should preserve validity timelines and historical contradictions rather than overwrite static text summaries.
operational_signature: Ingest episodes → resolve entities and facts → invalidate temporal conflicts → retrieve relevant context
load_bearing_mechanism: A bi-temporal knowledge graph preserves source episodes while updating fact validity and retrieving compact contextual evidence.

title: SkillForge: Forging Domain-Specific, Self-Evolving Agent Skills in Cloud Technical Support
problem: Domain-specific support skills stagnate because execution failures are not traced back to actionable skill deficiencies.
assumption_broken: Expert-authored or initially generated skills need not remain fixed after deployment.
operational_signature: Ground → execute → aggregate failures → diagnose → rewrite
load_bearing_mechanism: Batch failure attribution maps recurring execution errors to specific skill sections for targeted rewriting.

title: GRAFT-ATHENA: Self-Improving Agentic Teams for Autonomous Discovery and Evolutionary Numerical Algorithms
problem: Scientific agents restart method search because prior outcomes lack explicit admissibility and dependency structure.
assumption_broken: Scientific similarity and method-selection priors can be explicitly represented rather than left implicit in text or weights.
operational_signature: Encode → retrieve structural neighbors → propose and execute → retain outcomes
load_bearing_mechanism: Factored scientific graphs and semantic fingerprints turn validated neighboring cases into admissibility-constrained method priors.

title: From Experience to Strategy: Empowering LLM Agents with Trainable Graph Memory
problem: Static explicit memory cannot adaptively prioritize useful experience or effectively guide policy learning.
assumption_broken: Human-readable strategic memory need not remain untrained or be used only at inference.
operational_signature: Abstract paths → induce strategies → compare rewards → reweight graph → guide learning
load_bearing_mechanism: REINFORCE updates graph edges using the reward difference between strategy-guided and unguided trajectories, prioritizing causally useful guidance.

title: Self-Evolving Multi-Agent Collaboration Networks for Software Development
problem: Static human-designed multi-agent workflows cannot adapt to diverse software requirements.
assumption_broken: Agent prompts and collaboration topology can be revised for each test-time task.
operational_signature: Generate implementation → test against proxy → attribute failures → revise collaboration graph
load_bearing_mechanism: Textual backpropagation converts execution failures into agent-level prompt and topology changes.

title: Buffer of Thoughts: Thought-Augmented Reasoning with Large Language Models
problem: Reasoning methods repeatedly reconstruct expensive solution structures and fail to reuse general insights.
assumption_broken: Reusable high-level reasoning templates can replace fresh reasoning-structure search for each instance.
operational_signature: Distill constraints → retrieve template → instantiate solution → distill and update templates
load_bearing_mechanism: A dynamically managed meta-buffer stores general thought templates for adaptive instantiation on later problems.

title: Self-Consolidation for Self-Evolving Agents
problem: Success-only trajectory replay loses failure lessons and grows beyond practical context limits.
assumption_broken: Historical experience need not remain exclusively as retrieved text.
operational_signature: Contrast outcomes → extract lessons → distill experience → reuse hybrid memory
load_bearing_mechanism: Trajectory-rich teacher actions are distilled into compact learnable prompt tokens that complement recent textual insights.

title: Autopoiesis: A Self-Evolving System Paradigm for LLM Serving Under Runtime Dynamics
problem: Fixed serving policies cannot maintain optimal scheduling and reconfiguration trade-offs as workloads and cluster resources change.
assumption_broken: Serving policy code itself can change online rather than only producing new plans from a fixed algorithm.
operational_signature: Snapshot runtime → synthesize policy variants → evaluate completion time → deploy superior policy → observe drift
load_bearing_mechanism: An asynchronous control plane rewrites serving policies against recent runtime traces without interrupting live execution.

title: Enabling Autonomic Microservice Management through Self-Learning Agents
problem: General-purpose LLMs lack service-specific operational knowledge needed for autonomic microservice management.
assumption_broken: Agents can discover service configurations through curriculum-driven interaction instead of relying on supplied documentation.
operational_signature: Generate curriculum tasks → execute plans → refine with collective feedback → curate reusable skills
load_bearing_mechanism: Progressive environment exploration produces validated operational solutions consolidated into a reusable skill library.

title: EvoSafeHarness: Evolving Model- and Domain-Specific Harnesses for Securing Agents
problem: Fixed safety harnesses fail to balance security and utility across heterogeneous models and deployment domains.
assumption_broken: Security policies and runtime enforcement need not remain universal or expert-designed across deployments.
operational_signature: Propose → critique → execute → analyze → retain
load_bearing_mechanism: Jointly evolving semantic policies and executable enforcement under balanced behavioral feedback and instance-independent critique yields deployment-specific safety controls.

title: AgentNet: Decentralized Evolutionary Coordination for LLM-based Multi-Agent Systems
problem: Centralized multi-agent coordination creates bottlenecks and rigid roles that prevent adaptation and collaboration.
assumption_broken: Agent roles and communication topology can emerge from local experience instead of a fixed central orchestration plan.
operational_signature: Route → execute → retain → reweight
load_bearing_mechanism: Local trajectory memories specialize routers and executors while success-weighted edge updates prune ineffective collaborations.

title: Self-Evolving Embodied Agents via Skill-Harness Evolution
problem: Frozen embodied agents need target-environment adaptation without weight training or programmable low-level robot APIs.
assumption_broken: Train-free embodied adaptation can optimize planner guidance and context rather than low-level action programs.
operational_signature: Roll out → critique → summarize → rewrite → sandbox → rank
load_bearing_mechanism: Two-stage textual-gradient beam search evolves procedural skills followed by context-building code with the executor fixed.

title: AI4AI-Bench: Benchmarking LLM Agents in Algorithmic Design for Recursive Self-Improvement
problem: Existing agent benchmarks conflate algorithm design with data collection, hyperparameter tuning, and execution engineering.
assumption_broken: Editing training source is not sufficient evidence that an agent improves how a model learns.
operational_signature: Inspect → diagnose → edit → probe → submit → retrain → score
load_bearing_mechanism: A frozen post-submission evaluator reruns modified training source from scratch under a matched budget.

title: DataEvolver: Automatic Data Preparation for Large Language Models through Multi-Level Self-Evolving
problem: Automatically assembled data pipelines can execute incorrectly or miss seed-specified training-data quality.
assumption_broken: Both the operator library and its orchestration can evolve from small high-quality example specifications.
operational_signature: Infer profile → repair operator graph → trial and judge → accumulate discrepancies and rebuild
load_bearing_mechanism: Trial-output discrepancies update experience that jointly refines data understanding, operator capabilities, and pipeline structure.

title: Useful Memories Become Faulty When Continuously Updated by LLMs
problem: Repeated textual consolidation destroys useful trajectory evidence and degrades agent performance.
assumption_broken: More consolidated experience does not necessarily produce better reusable memory.
operational_signature: Preserve episodes → choose consolidation → update stores → measure utility
load_bearing_mechanism: Keeping raw episodes and gating consolidation avoids compounding lossy rewrites.

title: Socratic-Zero : Bootstrapping Reasoning via Data-Free Agent Co-evolution
problem: Static synthetic reasoning datasets cannot adapt to solver weaknesses or maintain useful curriculum difficulty.
assumption_broken: A learned curriculum generator can evolve with a solver rather than rely on a frozen synthetic corpus.
operational_signature: Attempt → judge → expose weakness → refine tasks → distill → retrain
load_bearing_mechanism: Teacher-verified preference learning improves the solver while utility-weighted distillation trains a generator near its competence frontier.

title: H-Mem: A Novel Memory Mechanism for Evolving and Retrieving Agent Memory via a Hybrid Structure
problem: Single-index memories cannot jointly support temporal consolidation and entity-centered multi-hop evidence retrieval.
assumption_broken: Memory retrieval need not choose between temporal abstraction trees and relational graphs.
operational_signature: Extract → consolidate by time and meaning → traverse relations → retrieve and refine evidence
load_bearing_mechanism: A coupled temporal-semantic tree and entity graph supports both long-term abstraction and multi-hop retrieval.

title: Continual Harness: Online Adaptation for Self-Improving Foundation Agents
problem: Embodied agents lack a reset-free mechanism for building and repairing long-horizon scaffolding online.
assumption_broken: Harness optimization need not reset episodes or leave scaffolding fixed during model learning.
operational_signature: Act → inspect failures → edit scaffolding → continue
load_bearing_mechanism: Periodic trajectory-conditioned CRUD edits update the live harness without resetting the environment.

title: Agentic Memory: Learning Unified Long-Term and Short-Term Memory Management for Large Language Model Agents
problem: Separate heuristic memory controllers limit long-horizon agents' coordinated use of persistent knowledge and finite context.
assumption_broken: Long-term and short-term memory decisions can be jointly learned as actions of the agent's own policy.
operational_signature: Observe information → store selectively → manage interference → retrieve and optimize outcomes
load_bearing_mechanism: Three-stage trajectories and step-wise GRPO propagate delayed task rewards to both storage and context-management decisions.

title: Beyond Scalar Rewards: Dense Feedback for LLM Policy Synthesis in Sequential Social Dilemmas
problem: Scalar self-play reward aliases different coordination failures requiring opposite policy corrections.
assumption_broken: Auxiliary social metrics can guide reward maximization without being explicit optimization objectives.
operational_signature: Generate policy → validate → self-play → expose diagnostic metrics → rewrite
load_bearing_mechanism: Dense efficiency, equality, sustainability, and peace feedback disambiguates failure modes during code-policy refinement.

title: LLMs as Continuous Learners: Improving the Reproduction of Defective Code in Software Issues
problem: Issue reproducers fail to learn recurring general and repository-specific reproduction conventions.
assumption_broken: Repository expertise can accumulate through editable textual experience rather than weight fine-tuning or static examples.
operational_signature: Attempt reproduction → inspect execution trajectory → distill lessons → update hierarchical experience
load_bearing_mechanism: A reflection agent maintains general and repository-specific experiences using add, remove, merge, endorse, and modify actions.

title: Scientific Algorithm Discovery by Augmenting AlphaEvolve with Deep Research
problem: Algorithm evolution plateaus when proposals rely only on internal model knowledge, while untested research ideas often cannot be implemented.
assumption_broken: Scientific code evolution need not operate without external research or restrict mutations to a single file.
operational_signature: Research → propose → edit → debug → evaluate → archive → sample
load_bearing_mechanism: Feedback-grounded deep research supplies implementable hypotheses to multi-file evolution with automatic debugging.

title: SelfSearch: Reward-Free Search for Self-Improving Agents
problem: Downstream-evaluation-guided agent search incurs recurring costs and binds modifications to its development tasks.
assumption_broken: Records of self-modification can guide transferable improvements without downstream rewards during search.
operational_signature: Inspect records → diagnose → edit self → check locally → archive → inherit
load_bearing_mechanism: Successors reuse shared self-modification episode records and become the next improvers without downstream-score selection.

title: LatentEvolve: Self-Evolving Test-Time Scaling in Latent Space
problem: Independent test-time reasoning runs discard optimization experience instead of improving future scaling.
assumption_broken: Inference-time adaptation can accumulate reusable optimization trajectories without changing the core LLM.
operational_signature: Retrieve → transfer momentum → refine → archive → consolidate
load_bearing_mechanism: Retrieved latent optimization deltas initialize new reasoning, while a learned weaver periodically consolidates high-confidence traces.

title: TabClaw: An Interactive and Self-Evolving Agent for Spreadsheet Manipulation and Table Reasoning
problem: Table agents repeatedly rediscover workflows and fail to preserve user preferences and corrective feedback.
assumption_broken: Completed analyses can become reusable personalized skills rather than disposable interaction traces.
operational_signature: Record workflows → discover recurring patterns → distill skills → revise from feedback
load_bearing_mechanism: Persistent workflow records support user-approved skill installation and feedback-driven revision across sessions.

title: SkillsVote: Lifecycle Governance of Agent Skills from Collection, Recommendation to Evolution
problem: Unfiltered skill exposure and misattributed execution lessons pollute growing reusable skill libraries.
assumption_broken: Successful trajectories should not automatically authorize library updates; reusable contributions require attribution and admissibility checks.
operational_signature: Search skills → execute task → attribute reusable success → gate and route edits
load_bearing_mechanism: Subtask-level attribution admits only successful reusable exploration and routes minimal edits or new-skill creation.

title: Bilevel Autoresearch: Meta-Autoresearching Itself
problem: A fixed autoresearch proposal loop repeats failed search directions and misses productive hyperparameter changes.
assumption_broken: The search mechanism itself can be discovered and injected at runtime rather than merely tuning its parameters.
operational_signature: Inspect traces → diagnose search bottleneck → specify mechanism → inject code → resume experiments
load_bearing_mechanism: An outer LLM loop writes executable search mechanisms that alter exploration in the inner research loop.

title: PACEvolve: Enabling Progress-Aware Consistent Evolution
problem: Evolutionary agents become trapped in polluted local histories and fail to coordinate parallel exploration effectively.
assumption_broken: Search history and restart or crossover schedules need not remain flat or fixed during evolutionary optimization.
operational_signature: Organize ideas → evaluate hypotheses → prune stale context → backtrack or exchange knowledge
load_bearing_mechanism: Hierarchical memory and progress-triggered backtracking preserve global exploration while adaptive collaboration shares useful directions.

title: Training LLM Agents for Spontaneous, Reward-Free Self-Evolution via World Knowledge Exploration
problem: Reactive web agents cannot reliably explore and summarize unfamiliar environments before receiving tasks.
assumption_broken: Environment adaptation need not require inference-time task rewards if useful exploration is learned during training.
operational_signature: Explore → summarize → measure downstream utility → select trajectories and fine-tune
load_bearing_mechanism: Outcome-based rejection sampling trains exploration policies to generate knowledge that improves downstream task success.

title: Automated Prompt Engineering for Cost-Effective Code Generation Using Evolutionary Algorithm
problem: Iterative code-repair agents consume many model calls and tokens when starting from inadequate prompts.
assumption_broken: Evolving the initial problem prompt with cheap lexical mutations can replace expensive execution-feedback conversations.
operational_signature: Generate prompt population → execute generated solutions → select by test fitness → mutate and preserve elite
load_bearing_mechanism: Test-fitness-weighted prompt evolution uses inexpensive similar-word substitutions to improve code generation economically.

title: Beyond RAG for Agent Memory: Retrieval by Decoupling and Aggregation
problem: Similarity retrieval over correlated interaction histories returns redundant context and obscures decisive differences.
assumption_broken: Agent memory should not be organized by compressing raw histories before isolating distinctive evidence.
operational_signature: Decouple evidence → aggregate components → revise groups → expand selectively
load_bearing_mechanism: Evidence-first decoupling creates revisable groups whose complementary contents are expanded only when they reduce reader uncertainty.

title: AnchorGUI: Asymmetric Memory for Dual-Scale Learning in GUI Navigation
problem: Dense visual histories obscure failure credit assignment and inflate GUI-agent context costs.
assumption_broken: Successful and unexpected transitions need not receive identical visual-memory retention.
operational_signature: Predict → act → compare → retain selectively → distill → retry
load_bearing_mechanism: Prediction-error verdicts preserve screenshots for mismatches while compressing expected transitions, focusing reflection on likely causal failures.

title: CyberEvolver: Structured Self-Evolution for Cybersecurity Agents On the Fly
problem: Fixed security-agent scaffolds fail to adapt to heterogeneous targets and obscured execution feedback.
assumption_broken: Target-specific scaffold changes can exceed the capability ceiling of repeatedly sampling an unchanged agent.
operational_signature: Execute → compress evidence → diagnose layers → branch mutations → retain promising variants
load_bearing_mechanism: Layer-attributed trajectory diagnosis guides diverse scaffold mutations maintained through population beam search.

title: PRINCIPLES: Synthetic Strategy Memory for Proactive Dialogue Agents
problem: Proactive dialogue planners have limited strategy coverage, preference bias, and expensive training requirements.
assumption_broken: Strategy knowledge can be elicited into reusable contrasting principles rather than learned through additional parameter updates.
operational_signature: Simulate → score → backtrack → revise → distill → retrieve
load_bearing_mechanism: Successful and repaired failed self-play turns yield situation-specific principles contrasting effective and ineffective strategies.

title: Guided Self-Evolving LLMs with Minimal Human Supervision
problem: Ungrounded self-play suffers concept drift, diversity collapse, and unstable reasoning gains.
assumption_broken: Self-evolution need not exclude small amounts of human-labeled grounding data.
operational_signature: Sample anchors → generate challenges → rank uncertainty → mix training → repeat
load_bearing_mechanism: Few-shot human anchors stabilize challenger generation while a mid-difficulty curriculum mixes human and synthetic solver training.

title: PyVision: Agentic Vision with Dynamic Tooling
problem: Static toolsets and single-turn workflows constrain flexible visual reasoning.
assumption_broken: Visual tools can be synthesized as task-specific Python programs rather than selected from predefined modules.
operational_signature: Inspect input → generate code → execute and observe → refine until answering
load_bearing_mechanism: Persistent multi-turn Python execution returns visual and textual feedback for dynamic tool refinement.

title: Think-in-Memory: Recalling and Post-thinking Enable LLMs with Long-Term Memory
problem: Repeatedly reasoning over recalled conversation history produces inconsistent answers and costly retrieval.
assumption_broken: Long-term memory can store derived thoughts rather than only raw conversation turns.
operational_signature: Recall relevant thoughts → respond → derive new thoughts → insert, forget, or merge
load_bearing_mechanism: Post-response reasoning persists inductive thoughts and consolidates them for direct later recall.

title: Mem0: Building Production-Ready AI Agents with Scalable Long-Term Memory
problem: Finite context and noisy long histories prevent consistent recall across multi-session conversations.
assumption_broken: Persistent conversational context should be selectively consolidated and revised instead of repeatedly passing the full history.
operational_signature: Extract → compare → consolidate → retrieve
load_bearing_mechanism: An LLM selects add, update, delete, or no-op operations on salient facts, with a graph variant preserving entity relationships.

title: PACE: Anytime-Valid Acceptance Tests for Self-Evolving Agents
problem: Greedy acceptance on noisy reused development data accumulates false and harmful self-modifications.
assumption_broken: A positive development-score difference is not sufficient evidence to commit an edit.
operational_signature: Propose → pair evaluations → accumulate statistical evidence → commit or reject
load_bearing_mechanism: A paired betting e-process admits edits only after crossing an anytime-valid per-candidate evidence threshold.

title: daVinci-kernel: Co-Evolving Skill Selection, Summarization, and Utilization via RL for GPU Kernel Optimization
problem: Kernel optimization libraries become stale as the generating policy improves.
assumption_broken: Skill retrieval and summarization need not remain fixed auxiliary components during policy training.
operational_signature: Retrieve → generate → execute → summarize → verify → jointly train
load_bearing_mechanism: Joint reinforcement learning aligns skill selection, utilization, and summarization while execution gates library additions.

title: ClawArena: Benchmarking AI Agents in Evolving Information Environments
problem: Static agent benchmarks do not test maintaining beliefs and implicit preferences under conflicting evolving evidence.
assumption_broken: Persistent-assistant reliability requires revision and personalization rather than static recall alone.
operational_signature: Expose partial sources → interact → inject updates → revise beliefs → verify grounded answers
load_bearing_mechanism: Hidden scenario truth and staged contradictory updates jointly test conflict resolution, belief revision, and silent preference retention.

title: SAGE: A Quantitative Evaluation of Socialized Evolution in Agent Ecosystems
problem: Isolated self-improvement evaluations cannot identify when public peer experience adds value beyond additional attempts.
assumption_broken: Access to peer histories is an experimental variable rather than a universally beneficial source of improvement.
operational_signature: Attempt → publish → filter → abstract → reuse → compare
load_bearing_mechanism: Compute-matched social and self-evolution conditions isolate the effects of peer-history visibility and representation.

title: One Recipe, Many Harnesses: What Self-Evolution Encodes Across Languages and Models
problem: Aggregate harness gains conceal whether edits capture reusable discipline or ecosystem-specific compensation.
assumption_broken: An evolved harness need not raise model capability; it can compensate recoverable execution defects in a setting-specific way.
operational_signature: Execute → attribute → route → edit → predict → validate
load_bearing_mechanism: Typed failure dossiers route falsifiable edits to harness components and later rollouts reject unsupported changes.

title: Self-Evolving World Models for LLM Agent Planning
problem: Frozen world models provide unreliable foresight that can harm agent action selection under deployment shifts.
assumption_broken: World-model adaptation can revise contextual evidence rather than model weights or the downstream agent.
operational_signature: Predict → gate → act → observe → compare → revise → retrieve
load_bearing_mechanism: Executed-action-aligned mismatches update semantic rules while episodic retrieval grounds predictions and confidence gates their exposure.

title: Self-Evolving Agentic Image Restoration via Deliberate Planning and Intuitive Execution
problem: Greedy restoration planning loses long-horizon quality and repeatedly discards expensive successful search trajectories.
assumption_broken: Restoration experience can become verified reusable execution expertise rather than transient per-image search.
operational_signature: Diagnose → retrieve → execute → gate → search → judge → consolidate
load_bearing_mechanism: Degradation-indexed episodic memory reuses high-reward trajectories under an outcome gate with tree-search fallback.

title: Prism: An Evolutionary Memory Substrate for Multi-Agent Open-Ended Discovery
problem: Open-ended multi-agent discovery needs persistent shared knowledge and adaptive retrieval without context saturation.
assumption_broken: Memory organization and retrieval strategies can evolve with downstream utility rather than remain fixed.
operational_signature: Extract → stratify and connect → retrieve adaptively → consolidate and decay
load_bearing_mechanism: Outcome-weighted retrieval strategy selection and memory confidence dynamics concentrate shared knowledge on useful reusable information.

title: AutoHarness: improving LLM agents by automatically synthesizing a code harness
problem: LLM agents lose tasks by emitting prohibited actions despite understanding task instructions.
assumption_broken: An action-validating harness or full policy need not be manually implemented or executed through repeated LLM reasoning.
operational_signature: Select code hypothesis → execute rollouts → consolidate errors → refine and rescore
load_bearing_mechanism: Thompson-sampled code search uses environment legality feedback to synthesize action filters, verifiers or complete policies.

title: General Agentic Memory Via Deep Research
problem: Ahead-of-time memory compression loses fine-grained historical details needed by unforeseen requests.
assumption_broken: Memory need not precompute a complete answer-ready representation before the query arrives.
operational_signature: Preserve pages → index highlights → plan search → integrate → reflect
load_bearing_mechanism: A lightweight memorizer preserves full history while a researcher constructs query-specific context through iterative search and reflection.

title: The Meta-Agent Challenge: Are Current Agents Capable of Autonomous Agent Development?
problem: Task-execution benchmarks do not measure autonomous development of agent systems.
assumption_broken: The agent scaffold can be an optimized output rather than a fixed human-designed evaluation component.
operational_signature: Implement → evaluate → diagnose → revise and test
load_bearing_mechanism: A sandboxed coding agent iteratively programs an agent artifact using development feedback before isolated held-out evaluation.

title: Self-Evolving Scientific Agent Designs Physically Reasoned White-Box Fluid Control
problem: Black-box fluid controllers are difficult to inspect and can generalize poorly across changing wakes.
assumption_broken: Autonomous fluid control can be designed as explicit feedback code without a deployed neural policy.
operational_signature: Sample designs and lessons → revise controller → simulate → retain and rank designers
load_bearing_mechanism: Co-evolving controller code and inherited design knowledge turns multimodal CFD evidence into reusable physical feedback structures.

title: SkillGraph: Self-Evolving Multi-Agent Collaboration with Multimodal Graph Topology
problem: Fixed collaboration graphs cannot exploit changing visual task demands or evolving agent expertise.
assumption_broken: Agent skills and communication topology should not be designed independently and frozen before inference.
operational_signature: Retrieve → encode → route → solve → diagnose → refine → re-encode
load_bearing_mechanism: Updated skill embeddings feed directly into a multimodal topology predictor so routing adapts to capability changes.

title: A Self-Evolving Agentic System for Automated Generation and Execution of Biological Protocols
problem: Biological intent and quantitative constraints become misaligned when protocols are translated into executable laboratory code.
assumption_broken: Protocol-to-code translation need not use a fixed skill set or end before physical experimental feedback.
operational_signature: Decompose → specify → translate → validate → execute → revise
load_bearing_mechanism: A runtime-revised library of parameter, layout and device-operation skills preserves constraints across protocol-to-code conversion.

title: TTHE: Test-Time Harness Evolution
problem: Fixed agent harnesses cannot adapt to task-specific execution failures encountered during unlabeled evaluation.
assumption_broken: Evaluation can update executable control logic without access to final-answer labels or model gradients.
operational_signature: Execute → inspect → branch → edit → judge → carry forward
load_bearing_mechanism: Diverse trace-guided harness edits are selected with execution-derived partial checks and persisted across batches.

title: EvoAgentX: An Automated Framework for Evolving Agentic Workflows
problem: Multi-agent frameworks require manual workflow design and lack unified optimization support.
assumption_broken: Prompts, tool configurations, and workflow topology can be automatically refined within one framework.
operational_signature: Generate workflow → execute tasks → evaluate outputs → optimize configuration and structure
load_bearing_mechanism: A unified evolving layer integrates existing prompt and workflow optimizers with standardized evaluation.

title: HarnessCompass: Guiding Automatic Harness Evolution toward Generalizable and Effective Agent Harnesses
problem: Unrestricted joint harness evolution overfits search tasks, misattributes failures, and produces interfering edits.
assumption_broken: Giving a meta-agent maximal editing freedom and only external trajectories is not the best route to transferable harness improvements.
operational_signature: Evaluate → ground feedback → constrain edits → optimize separate tracks → reconcile → retain
load_bearing_mechanism: Task-agnostic edit constraints and trajectory-grounded feedback guide separate component tracks before their validated changes are reconciled.

title: G-Memory: Tracing Hierarchical Memory for Multi-Agent Systems
problem: Simple multi-agent memories discard collaboration details and cannot provide role-specific cross-trial knowledge.
assumption_broken: Team memory requires hierarchical collaboration-aware retrieval rather than direct reuse of single-agent memory designs.
operational_signature: Retrieve related cases → traverse abstraction levels → customize context → execute and update memory
load_bearing_mechanism: Bidirectional traversal of insight, query, and interaction graphs supplies role-specific abstract guidance and condensed trajectories.

title: FORGE: Self-Evolving Agent Memory With No Weight Updates via Population Broadcast
problem: Isolated reflection accumulates unreliable memory and heavy-tailed failures in stochastic decision-making.
assumption_broken: Gradient-free agent learning needs population-level selection rather than only better single-stream reflections.
operational_signature: Fail → reflect → checkpoint → broadcast champion and freeze graduates
load_bearing_mechanism: Between-stage champion memory broadcast propagates rare useful discoveries while graduation conserves compute.

title: CoEvoSkills: Self-Evolving Agent Skills via Co-Evolutionary Verification
problem: One-shot multi-file skill generation lacks reliable dense feedback for discovering robust professional workflows.
assumption_broken: A verifier can evolve alongside skills using observable artifacts and opaque oracle bits rather than fixed tests or revealed answers.
operational_signature: Generate skill → execute → synthesize assertions → diagnose failures → refine skill or escalate verifier
load_bearing_mechanism: An isolated surrogate verifier supplies dense diagnostics and strengthens tests when surrogate success conflicts with the hidden oracle.

title: Polaris: A Gödel Agent Framework for Small Language Models through Experience-Abstracted Policy Repair
problem: Small models cannot sustain unconstrained policy self-repair because reflection histories cause context growth and execution failures.
assumption_broken: Persistent policy repair need not retain extensive raw failures and unconstrained rewrite histories.
operational_signature: Execute → diagnose failures → abstract strategies → generate minimal patches → check and integrate
load_bearing_mechanism: Compact experience abstraction converts a few failure reflections into localized executable policy patches with bounded integration retries.

title: STELLA: Self-Evolving LLM Agent for Biomedical Research
problem: Static curated tools cannot keep biomedical agents aligned with rapidly evolving research capabilities.
assumption_broken: An agent's tool repertoire and reasoning workflows can expand through task experience rather than remain predefined.
operational_signature: Plan analysis → execute and critique → create missing capabilities → retain reusable strategies
load_bearing_mechanism: A growing Tool Ocean and Template Library preserve newly integrated tools and successful reasoning workflows.

title: ANNEAL: Adapting LLM Agents via Governed Symbolic Patch Learning
problem: Episodic recovery does not remove recurring failures rooted in unrepaired symbolic operator definitions.
assumption_broken: Durable adaptation can directly edit typed process knowledge rather than prompts, memories, or weights.
operational_signature: Localize fault → synthesize typed patch → verify and canary → commit with rollback
load_bearing_mechanism: Failure-driven acquisition installs governed symbolic operator repairs that prevent same-root recurrence.

title: SkillClaw: Let Skills Evolve Collectively with Agentic Evolver
problem: Procedural fixes discovered during individual user sessions do not accumulate into shared improvements.
assumption_broken: Skills can evolve from pooled cross-user execution evidence rather than remain manually maintained deployment artifacts.
operational_signature: Aggregate sessions → group by skill → diagnose shared patterns → edit or create skills → validate and synchronize
load_bearing_mechanism: Joint reasoning over successful and failed sessions across users identifies reusable repairs while preserving working procedures.

title: TeleMem: Building Long-Term and Multimodal Memory for Agentic AI
problem: Fragmented retrieval and per-turn memory writes cause inconsistent user profiles, hallucinated attributes, and inefficient long-term recall.
assumption_broken: Persistent memories need not remain independent unordered fragments or conform to a fixed profile schema.
operational_signature: Extract grounded narratives → cluster related memories → consolidate states → retrieve dependency closure
load_bearing_mechanism: Coordinated batch consolidation and threaded dependency-aware retrieval preserve coherent memory trajectories rather than isolated facts.

title: EVOMAL: Self-Poisoning in Self-Evolving Coding Agents
problem: Retrieved malicious skills can be copied into agent-authored skills and persist after the original plants are removed.
assumption_broken: Agent-authored skills are not inherently trustworthy merely because attacker-submitted entries were screened or removed.
operational_signature: Retrieve → imitate → author → persist → execute → propagate
load_bearing_mechanism: Benign-looking structural banners cause imitation-based skill authoring to preserve and recirculate an embedded payload.

title: SEARL: Joint Optimization of Policy and Tool Graph Memory for Self-Evolving Agents
problem: Sparse outcome rewards and unstructured generated tools limit small agents' credit assignment and reusable problem solving.
assumption_broken: Policy learning and external tool-memory growth can be optimized together, using shared tools rather than identical states to group actions.
operational_signature: Decompose tasks → create and reuse tools → group actions by memory anchors → update policy → consolidate tool graph
load_bearing_mechanism: Memory-anchored step advantages compare actions involving equivalent tools across trajectories to densify credit assignment.

title: DR Tulu: Reinforcement Learning with Evolving Rubrics for Deep Research
problem: Static reward criteria inadequately supervise knowledge-intensive long-form research and invite reward hacking.
assumption_broken: Evaluation rubrics can evolve with the policy rather than remaining fixed throughout training.
operational_signature: Sample responses → contrast evidence → update rubrics → score → train
load_bearing_mechanism: Search-grounded positive and negative rubrics co-evolve with responses and are retained according to their reward-discriminating variance.

title: Search Self-play: Pushing the Frontier of Agent Capability without Supervision
problem: Agentic reinforcement learning is constrained by scarce verified questions and static synthetic task difficulty.
assumption_broken: Search training tasks need not be supplied by humans or a frozen offline synthesizer.
operational_signature: Search → propose → verify → challenge → reinforce
load_bearing_mechanism: RAG verification filters unanswerable proposals while adversarial proposer-solver co-training continually raises task difficulty.

title: Get Experience from Practice: LLM Agents with Record & Replay
problem: Uncertain repeated LLM planning makes agent execution unreliable, costly, slow, and privacy sensitive.
assumption_broken: Agents can replay generalized checked experiences rather than regenerate every task plan from scratch.
operational_signature: Record → abstract → retrieve → check
load_bearing_mechanism: Multi-level reusable experiences pair flexible replay with trusted check functions enforcing workflow and safety constraints.

title: CoPS: Empowering LLM Agents with Provable Cross-Task Experience Sharing
problem: Reflection lacks novel experience and naive retrieval can introduce distribution-mismatched trajectories.
assumption_broken: Experience sharing need not be task-local or depend on manually curated demonstrations.
operational_signature: Collect experiences → match distributions → sample successful trajectories → act and store
load_bearing_mechanism: Pessimism-inspired retrieval balances successful experience utility against distance from the current task distribution.

title: MM-Zero: Self-Evolving Multi-Model Vision Language Models From Zero Data
problem: Multimodal self-evolution remains constrained by preexisting image datasets even when textual supervision is synthetic.
assumption_broken: A vision-language training loop can synthesize its own images through code rather than require seed visual data.
operational_signature: Propose visual tasks → render through code → verify and balance difficulty → train roles in sequence
load_bearing_mechanism: Co-evolving proposer, renderer and solver create a filtered visual curriculum using execution and answer-consistency rewards.

title: Self-Play Only Evolves When Self-Synthetic Pipeline Ensures Learnable Information Gain
problem: Self-play pipelines often plateau or collapse because synthetic data does not sustain learnable information gains.
assumption_broken: More self-generated data and reward optimization alone do not ensure sustained self-evolution.
operational_signature: Propose tasks → solve and verify → estimate learnable structure → synchronize roles and expand budgets
load_bearing_mechanism: The paper argues for asymmetric role synchronization, capacity growth and external information acquisition to sustain learnable information.

title: Memory Reward Inflation in Self-Improving LLM Agents
problem: Self-graded incorrect memories receive inflated utility and compound errors through repeated trusted reuse.
assumption_broken: A stronger parametric re-grader is insufficient when its errors remain correlated with the original memory bias.
operational_signature: Retrieve episodes → generate answer → self-grade → audit behavior → demote utility → store
load_bearing_mechanism: Answer-free execution, degeneracy, and literal-grounding checks demote suspect memory utilities without rewriting content or consulting gold answers.

title: EXG: Self-Evolving Agents with Experience Graphs
problem: Task-local reflections and fragmented memories prevent immediate reuse of successes and failure repairs across tasks.
assumption_broken: Online experience can remain directly reusable offline without a separate consolidation pipeline.
operational_signature: Abstract outcome → link cases → retrieve corrective hints → execute and extend graph
load_bearing_mechanism: Typed similarity and correction edges connect warning cases to successful repairs for bounded failure-aware retrieval.

title: EvoPrompt: Connecting LLMs with Evolutionary Algorithms Yields Powerful Prompt Optimizers
problem: Automatically discover effective discrete prompts without gradient access or extensive manual prompt engineering.
assumption_broken: Evolutionary operators need not edit independent tokens because an LLM can implement coherent mutation and crossover in natural language.
operational_signature: Initialize candidates → recombine and mutate → score candidates → retain fitter candidates → repeat
load_bearing_mechanism: LLM-executed genetic or differential-evolution operators combine coherent prompt generation with fitness-guided population search.

title: MMG2Skill: Can Agents Distill In-the-Wild Guides into Self-Evolving Skills?
problem: Human-oriented multimodal guides lack runtime grounding and cannot reliably guide agent execution as raw context.
assumption_broken: Public guides can become editable executable skills revised from visible trajectories without benchmark-score feedback.
operational_signature: Compile → execute → diagnose → revise → retry → stop
load_bearing_mechanism: Trajectory-level root-cause diagnoses localize guide-runtime mismatches into persistent skill edits with analyzer-based early stopping.

title: Automated Design of Agentic Systems
problem: Hand-designed agent building blocks and workflows constrain the pace and scope of agent development.
assumption_broken: Entire agent designs can be searched as executable programs rather than restricted to predefined prompt or graph spaces.
operational_signature: Inspect discovery archive → program novel design → evaluate and repair → archive scored design
load_bearing_mechanism: An expanding archive preserves stepping stones that a coding meta-agent recombines into novel agent designs.

title: The Prompt Alchemist: Automated LLM-Tailored Prompt Optimization for Test Case Generation
problem: Generic test-generation prompts lack diversity, error guidance, and project context.
assumption_broken: Different LLMs require different test-generation instructions and learned error-avoidance rules.
operational_signature: Extract context → diversify instructions → cluster failures → induce and validate rules
load_bearing_mechanism: Diverse instruction search combines with execution-validated concise rules distilled from recurring test failures.

title: Harnessing Pre-Resolution Signals for Future Prediction Agents
problem: Forecast outcomes arrive too late and too coarsely to guide procedural improvement while a question remains unresolved.
assumption_broken: Useful adaptation signals can be extracted before ground-truth outcomes become available.
operational_signature: Forecast → compare temporal notes → diagnose → patch typed guidance → revisit → audit
load_bearing_mechanism: Bounded question-local harness updates convert temporal evidence contrasts into reusable tracking, verification, and uncertainty guidance.
